findings.description: [adversarial] New except blocks for SystemExit and KeyboardInterrupt are placed after the existing except block's body (after return EXIT_FAIL), making them syntactically invalid. They will not be attached to the try block, causing a syntax error or leaving those exceptions unhandled. The correct placement should be before the existing except block's body, i.e., before line 1656.

except SystemExit as exc:

            # its own code (1 reads like FAIL) and leaves no receipts.

            # showing the raise site.

                "code-forge: internal error: SystemExit(%s) escaped "

            print("code-forge: interrupted", file=sys.stderr)

            ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
            capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8",
            errors="replace", cwd=cwd, check=False,
        ).stdout.strip()[:8]

            diff_count=_banner_diff_count,
            mode=mode.value.lower(),
            backend_name=backend.name if backend is not None else "none",
            timeout_s=_banner_timeout,
